quotes.text:
Had three excellent sessions with Sanjee, plus board rental for the following days. He’s building his own school with real passion, and it shows.
As an intermediate surfer, we went straight to the green waves at Coco Beach. From getting dropped off by tuk-tuk to being in the water took about 10 minutes. One session was at 6am, which was great as the line up was empty. After the session, the beach huts nearby had cold, well-priced coconuts.
A friend of mine booked a private beginner session and was already standing up in the first lesson, really nice experience.
Booked through the website and everything went smoothly.
quotes.author: Dr. Marcel Panzer
quotes.why: the reviewer has the same name as the site's legal operator (Terms, Imprint: Marcel Panzer, operating as "Sanjee Surf"). Whether it is the same person is not proven, but this cannot stand as an independent guest review until a human has checked. Kept here for its facts only.

quotes.text: Sanjee is one the best coaches there is to learn surfing.  He was very patient. And supportive.  I was able to catch waves and stand on my board till close to the shore in the first session itself. Id definitely recommend him and would come again to learn from him for intermediate and advanced course as well.
quotes.author: samagra singh

quotes.text: Great guy. Better then most other surf instructors i met before. Very calm and patient. Highly recommend.
quotes.author: Tim St

quotes.text: I would definitely recommend going out with Sanjee. I spent two mornings surfing with him and it was amazing. He made sure I was always in the best positions to catch the wave on the local break, meaning I was catching far more waves than if i was on my own. He is very friendly and a joy to surf with.
quotes.author: hal starkie

quotes.text: Sanjee is an outstanding surf coach. After just 7 intensive training days, he gave me the confidence to surf bigger waves and significantly improve my level. His teaching is clear, professional, and very motivating. I highly recommend him to anyone who wants to progress safely and effectively.”
quotes.author: Rossana Encina

notes: Scrolls sideways: 417 px wide in a 390 px phone viewport (the scout measured 438 in 412), and 1446 in 1440.
Home page contact block still shows a template placeholder as its location: "Tropical Beach, Paradise Coast".
Home page contact block prints sanjee@sanjeesurf.com; that domain has no MX or A record and did not answer (checked 2026-11-05), so mail to it cannot arrive.
Home page has no phone number and no WhatsApp link at all.
All three social links in the footer are dead (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube), and the rental page still says "or message us on Instagram".

Surf report shows "TODAY'S SURF RATING 5/5 Excellent" with 4-5 ft waves right beside "Live data temporarily unavailable. Showing estimated conditions.", seen on the first browser load of this harvest. Corrected at station 3b (audit.md F4): the 5/5 comes from the function's successful answers, and the "unavailable" line and a red "Could not refresh surf conditions" toast come from a 429 that the page provokes itself by calling surf-conditions in a loop until the server refuses. The toast showed on 3 of 3 fresh loads after the harvest ended, so it is not just this harvest's load. Do not say a failed feed shows a top rating. "Every visitor" rests on the code: no other network or real phone was tested.
Structured data claims 150 reviews; Google has 13. Home page review block shows "1 week ago" against Google's 7–10 months.
First screen is an infinity pool, labelled in its alt text as the school's location; no surfer, no water sports, in a business with surf action to show.
The cookie notice takes the lower part of the first phone screen.
Blog art looks machine-generated (for example a pyramid-shaped hill behind "Kabalana"), while the blog says "no second-hand info, no AI summaries".
The site contradicts itself on price, deposit, cancellation, experience and student numbers (see contradictions).

flags_for_operator: Who the owner is. Terms, Privacy and Imprint name Marcel Panzer of Berlin as the provider "operating as Sanjee Surf", not Sanjee. A 5-star Google review, one of 13, is by "Dr. Marcel Panzer"; same name, not proven the same person. Its quote is marked do_not_use. The writer needs to know who actually decides before any pitch.

This is not a weak-presence business in the usual sense: a 67-page, actively maintained site (tours added 2026-10-22) with its own booking and Stripe flow and a large blog. It scored low on one measured fault, sideways scroll. The case for a new site is its visible errors and contradictions, and whoever built it may be the person we would be pitching.
Video is the known hole: the business has two clips on Google that could not be fetched without working around a 403. A human can decide how to obtain them, or go ahead on stills.
